ja439:1.1: Catudvāram idaṃ nagaraṃ āyasaṃ daḷhapākāraṃ, oruddhapatiruddho 'smi kiṃ pāpaṃ pakatam mayā.
ja439:2.1: Sabbe apihitā dvārā, oruddho 'smi yathā dvijo, kimādhikaraṇaṃ yakkha cakkābhinihato ahan ti.
ja439:3.1: Laddhā satasahassāni atirekāni vīsati anukampakānaṃ ñātīnaṃ vacanaṃ samma nākari.
ja439:4.1: Laṃghī samuddaṃ pakkhandi sāgaraṃ appasiddhikaṃ, catūhi aṭṭh' ajjhagamā aṭṭhāhi pi ca soḷasa (=III p. 207.)
ja439:5.1: Soḷasāhi ca battiṃsa, atriccho cakkam āsado, icchāhatassa posassa cakkaṃ bhamati matthake.
ja439:6.1: Uparivisālaṃ duppūraṃ icchāvisaṭagāminiṃ ye va taṃ anugijjhanti te honti cakkadhārino.
ja439:7.1: Bahuṃ bhaṇḍaṃ apahāya maggaṃ appaṭivekkhiya yesaṃ c' etaṃ asaṃkhātaṃ te honti cakkadhārino.
ja439:8.1: Kammaṃ samekkhe vipulañ ca bhogaṃ, icchaṃ na seveyya anatthasaṃhitaṃ, kareyya vākyaṃ anukampakānaṃ, taṃ tādisaṃ nātivatteyya cakkan ti.
ja439:9.1: Kīva ciraṃ nu me yakkha cakkaṃ sirasi ṭhassati, kati vassasahassāni, tam me akkhāhi pucchito ti.
ja439:10.1: Atisaro accasaro Mittavinda, suṇohi me: cakkaṃ te sirasi-m- āviddhaṃ, na taṃ jīvaṃ pamokkhasīti.
